title: Adventures of the Big Boy #157 July 1969 Bobs Big Boy Restaurant Promo Comic
conditionDescription: Toning, spine and edge wear, chipped lower corner front and back. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
descriptionText:
Adventures of the Big Boy #157 (July 1969) -- the Bob's Big Boy restaurant giveaway comic, West Coast edition, with the "Compliments of Bob's Family Restaurants" back cover listing the California, Nevada and Arizona locations. Knight-in-armor cover with Dolly and Nugget; "Free to our Guests / 10c" cover price. Published by Webs Adventure Corp. for Big Boy Restaurants.

Condition: Good. Toning to the newsprint, spine and edge wear, and a chipped lower corner on the front and back covers (see the close-up photos). Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
